note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Swan outline and wing-stripe edges are soft and haloed at 1:1 (cubic upscale), not crisp flat-art edges.
flags.fix: Redraw the swan silhouette as vector or edge-snap the outline (as done for 04british), then keep the crisp black/white edge.

flags.problem: A thin magenta/pink line runs along the top edge of the result, carried over from the original; the streak texture itself reads well.
flags.fix: Check the top 1-2 rows for magenta or pink pixels (alpha or colour). If they are real texels, fill them from the neighbouring rows so no pink stripe tiles in game.

flags.problem: Grit injection looks like uniform speckle noise on the flat grey plate and zigzag areas at 1:1, not the smoother original paint.
flags.fix: Reduce Metal046B grit amplitude on the flat plate areas, keep it only on the rusty upper section, and re-run the 1:1 check.
